paragraphs: Computer Information Systems builds technology driven, mission critical public safety software systems. It sells to state, local, and governmental entities.

The computer aided dispatch program enables dispatchers to manage incidents. The records management system automates the records management functions of an agency. A jail management system covers inmate management, facilities management, billing, and special programs. A mobile computer system puts the same records screens and text reporting on a laptop. Specific programs handle each state's own crime reporting and NCIC access.

The company says it has been providing solutions for over 30 years. It lists 24 x 7 x 365 maintenance and support, enhancements, and new releases among its hallmarks. It also states a policy of no third party software or outsourcing. Systems are kept off the shelf while each agency's copy is customized to its own operation, the company says.
